fields.description: Deaths from any cause combined, used as an overall measure of fatal burden without attribution to a specific disease or condition.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|0
fields.title: Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional mortality Category - Infectious diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths caused by infectious and parasitic diseases, including respiratory, enteric, vector-borne, and other infections.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|1
fields.title: Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional mortality Category - Maternal mortality
fields.description: Deaths among women during pregnancy, childbirth, or the postpartum period attributable to obstetric causes.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|2
fields.title: Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional mortality Category - Neonatal mortality
fields.description: Deaths occurring in the first 28 days of life, attributable to preterm birth, birth asphyxia, neonatal infection, and congenital conditions.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|3
fields.title: Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional mortality Category - Nutrition-related mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to nutritional deficiencies and undernutrition, including protein-energy malnutrition and micronutrient deficiency disorders.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|0
fields.title: Infectious diseases mortality Category - Enteric infections mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to enteric infections transmitted via contaminated food or water, including diarrhoeal diseases and typhoid.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|1
fields.title: Infectious diseases mortality Category - Neglected tropical diseases and malaria mortality
fields.description: Deaths caused by neglected tropical diseases and malaria, disproportionately affecting populations in low-income tropical settings.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|2
fields.title: Infectious diseases mortality Category - Other infectious diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths from infectious diseases not classified under respiratory, enteric, or vector-borne categories, including meningitis, encephalitis, and vaccine-preventable infections.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|3
fields.title: Infectious diseases mortality Category - Respiratory infections mortality (including tuberculosis)
fields.description: Deaths caused by infections of the respiratory tract, including tuberculosis, pneumonia, and other lower and upper respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|0
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Cardiovascular mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to diseases of the heart and circulatory system, including ischemic heart disease, stroke, and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|1
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Chronic respiratory diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to chronic conditions of the respiratory tract, including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|2
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Diabetes and kidney diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease, which frequently co-occur and share common risk pathways.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|3
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Injury-related mortality (drowning, fires, disasters, suicide, violence)
fields.description: Deaths resulting from injuries including drowning, fires, natural disasters, suicide, and interpersonal violence.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|4
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Neoplasms mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to malignant and benign neoplasms across all anatomical sites.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|5
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality Category - Other non-communicable diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to non-communicable diseases not classified under the major NCD categories of cardiovascular, respiratory, neoplastic, or metabolic disease.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|0
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Enteric infections
fields.description: Infections of the gastrointestinal tract transmitted via contaminated food or water, including diarrhoeal diseases, typhoid, and cholera.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|1
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - HIV/AIDS and sexually transmitted infections
fields.description: Infections transmitted through sexual contact or blood-borne routes, including HIV/AIDS and bacterial and viral sexually transmitted infections.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|2
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Maternal and neonatal disorders
fields.description: Conditions arising during pregnancy, childbirth, or the neonatal period, including obstetric complications and disorders of the newborn.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|3
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Neglected tropical diseases and malaria
fields.description: A diverse group of infectious diseases that disproportionately affect populations in tropical and subtropical low-income settings, including parasitic, bacterial, and viral conditions.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|4
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Nutritional deficiencies
fields.description: Conditions arising from insufficient intake of macro- or micronutrients, including protein-energy malnutrition and deficiencies in key vitamins and minerals.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|5
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Respiratory infections and tuberculosis
fields.description: Acute and chronic infections of the respiratory tract, including tuberculosis, pneumonia, and upper respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|6
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases Category - Z_Other infectious diseases
fields.description: Infectious diseases not classified under respiratory, enteric, or vector-borne categories, including bacterial, viral, and prion conditions of diverse transmission routes.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|0
fields.title: Enteric infections Category - Diarrheal diseases
fields.description: Illness characterised by loose or watery stools, caused by a range of enteric pathogens and strongly associated with unsafe water, poor sanitation, and food contamination.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|1
fields.title: Enteric infections Category - Invasive Non-typhoidal Salmonella (iNTS)
fields.description: Severe systemic infection caused by non-typhoidal Salmonella serovars invading the bloodstream, predominantly affecting young children and immunocompromised individuals in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|2
fields.title: Enteric infections Category - Typhoid and paratyphoid
fields.description: Systemic bacterial infections caused by Salmonella Typhi and Salmonella Paratyphi, transmitted via contaminated food and water.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|3
fields.title: Enteric infections Category - Z_Other intestinal infectious diseases
fields.description: Intestinal infectious diseases not classified under diarrhoea, cholera, typhoid, or iNTS, including other bacterial, viral, and parasitic gut infections.

fields.name: dsny000325_sub|0
fields.title: Diarrheal diseases Category - Cholera
fields.description: An acute diarrhoeal illness caused by the bacterium Vibrio cholerae, typically transmitted through contaminated water and capable of causing rapid dehydration and death.

fields.name: dsny000315_sub|0
fields.title: HIV/AIDS and sexually transmitted infections Category - HIV/AIDS
fields.description: Infection caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), which progressively damages the immune system and, without treatment, leads to acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

fields.name: dsny000315_sub|1
fields.title: HIV/AIDS and sexually transmitted infections Category - Sexually transmitted infections excluding HIV
fields.description: Infections transmitted primarily through sexual contact, excluding HIV, including syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia, and other sexually transmitted pathogens.

fields.name: dsny000364_sub|0
fields.title: Maternal and neonatal disorders Category - Maternal disorders
fields.description: Medical conditions and complications directly related to pregnancy and childbirth, including haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, obstructed labour, and sepsis.

fields.name: dsny000364_sub|1
fields.title: Maternal and neonatal disorders Category - Neonatal disorders
fields.description: Conditions originating in the perinatal period affecting newborns, including preterm birth, birth asphyxia, neonatal infections, and congenital anomalies.

fields.name: dsny000365_sub|0
fields.title: Maternal disorders Category - Maternal abortion and miscarriage
fields.description: The spontaneous or induced termination of pregnancy before viability, including miscarriage, unsafe abortion, and related complications.

fields.name: dsny000367_sub|0
fields.title: Neonatal disorders Category - Low birth weight
fields.description: Birth weight below 2,500 grams, associated with increased neonatal mortality, infection susceptibility, and long-term developmental and metabolic risk.

fields.name: dsny000367_sub|1
fields.title: Neonatal disorders Category - Neonatal preterm birth
fields.description: Birth occurring before 37 completed weeks of gestation, associated with increased risk of respiratory distress, infection, neurodevelopmental impairment, and neonatal death.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|0
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - African trypanosomiasis
fields.description: A vector-borne parasitic disease caused by Trypanosoma brucei, transmitted by tsetse flies, causing progressive neurological deterioration if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|1
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Chagas disease
fields.description: A vector-borne parasitic disease caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, transmitted by triatomine bugs and endemic to Latin America, with chronic cardiac and digestive complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|2
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Chikungunya
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, causing acute fever and severe joint pain that can persist for months.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|3
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Cystic echinococcosis
fields.description: A zoonotic parasitic disease caused by the larval stage of Echinococcus granulosus tapeworm, producing fluid-filled cysts predominantly in the liver and lungs.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|4
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Cysticercosis
fields.description: Infection by the larval stage of the pork tapeworm Taenia solium, which can invade the brain causing neurocysticercosis, a leading cause of acquired epilepsy.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|5
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Dengue
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection caused by dengue virus serotypes, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, producing fever, severe headache, and in severe cases haemorrhagic complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|6
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Ebola
fields.description: A severe and often fatal viral haemorrhagic fever caused by Ebola virus, characterised by fever, bleeding, and multi-organ failure.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|7
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Food-borne trematodiases
fields.description: Parasitic infections caused by trematode flatworms acquired through consumption of contaminated raw or undercooked fish, crustaceans, or aquatic plants.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|8
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Guinea worm disease
fields.description: A parasitic infection caused by Dracunculus medinensis, acquired by drinking water containing infected copepods, resulting in a slowly emerging worm through the skin.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|9
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Intestinal nematode infections
fields.description: Parasitic worm infections transmitted through soil contaminated with faecal matter, including ascariasis, hookworm, and trichuriasis, causing malnutrition and developmental impairment.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|10
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Leishmaniasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Leishmania species, transmitted by sandflies, presenting as cutaneous, mucocutaneous, or visceral forms.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|11
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Leprosy
fields.description: A chronic bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium leprae, affecting the skin, peripheral nerves, and mucous membranes, and historically associated with significant stigma.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|12
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Leptospirosis
fields.description: A bacterial zoonosis caused by Leptospira species, transmitted through contact with water or soil contaminated by infected animal urine, with risk elevated during flooding events.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|13
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Lymphatic filariasis
fields.description: A mosquito-transmitted parasitic disease caused by filarial worms, leading to lymphatic damage, lymphoedema, and disfiguring swelling of the limbs and genitals.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|14
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Malaria
fields.description: A parasitic disease transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, caused by Plasmodium species, producing fever, anaemia, and potentially fatal cerebral complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|15
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Onchocerciasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus, transmitted by blackflies near fast-flowing rivers, causing skin disease and progressive visual impairment leading to blindness.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|16
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Rabies
fields.description: A fatal viral encephalitis caused by lyssavirus, transmitted through the bite of infected animals, almost universally fatal once clinical symptoms develop.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|17
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Schistosomiasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Schistosoma flatworms, transmitted through contact with contaminated freshwater, causing chronic inflammation of the bladder, liver, and intestines.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|18
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Trachoma
fields.description: A chronic bacterial eye infection caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, the leading infectious cause of preventable blindness worldwide.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|19
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Yellow fever
fields.description: An acute viral haemorrhagic disease transmitted by Aedes and Haemagogus mosquitoes, endemic in tropical Africa and South America.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|20
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Zika virus
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection caused by Zika virus, typically mild in adults but associated with congenital microcephaly and Guillain-Barré syndrome.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|21
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria Category - Zz_Other neglected tropical diseases
fields.description: Neglected tropical diseases not classified under specific GBD sub-categories, including other parasitic and bacterial infections endemic to tropical regions.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|0
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Childhood stunting and wasting
fields.description: Growth faltering in children due to chronic undernutrition (stunting: low height-for-age) or acute undernutrition (wasting: low weight-for-height), with serious consequences for development and survival.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|1
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Dietary iron deficiency
fields.description: Insufficient dietary iron intake leading to iron deficiency anaemia, impairing oxygen transport, cognitive development, and immune function.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|2
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Iodine deficiency
fields.description: Conditions resulting from insufficient dietary iodine, including goitre, hypothyroidism, and cretinism, with adverse effects on thyroid function and neurodevelopment.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|3
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Protein-energy malnutrition
fields.description: Severe deficiency of protein and energy intake, manifesting as marasmus (energy deficiency) or kwashiorkor (protein deficiency), predominantly affecting young children in food-insecure settings.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|4
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Vitamin A deficiency
fields.description: Deficiency of vitamin A resulting in night blindness, increased susceptibility to infection, and xerophthalmia, predominantly affecting children and pregnant women.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|5
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies Category - Z_Other nutritional deficiencies
fields.description: Nutritional deficiency conditions not elsewhere classified, including deficiencies in zinc, folate, calcium, and other micronutrients essential for health.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|0
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis Category - COVID-19
fields.description: Respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, ranging from mild infection to severe pneumonia, acute respiratory distress, and multi-organ failure.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|1
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis Category - Lower respiratory infections
fields.description: Infections of the lower respiratory tract including the lungs and bronchi, such as pneumonia and bronchiolitis, representing a leading cause of morbidity and mortality.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|2
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis Category - Otitis media
fields.description: Infection and inflammation of the middle ear, commonly caused by bacterial or viral pathogens following upper respiratory infection.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|3
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis Category - Tuberculosis
fields.description: A chronic bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs but capable of affecting any organ system.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|4
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis Category - Upper respiratory infections
fields.description: Infections of the upper respiratory tract including the nose, throat, sinuses, and larynx, typically caused by viruses.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|0
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Acute hepatitis
fields.description: Acute inflammatory liver disease caused by hepatitis A, B, C, D, or E viruses, ranging from self-limiting illness to fulminant hepatic failure.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|1
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Diphtheria
fields.description: A vaccine-preventable bacterial infection caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, producing a toxin that causes a characteristic pharyngeal membrane and life-threatening airway obstruction and cardiac complications.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|2
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Encephalitis
fields.description: Inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral, bacterial, or autoimmune processes, presenting with altered consciousness, seizures, and focal neurological signs.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|3
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Lyme disease
fields.description: A tick-borne bacterial infection caused by Borrelia burgdorferi, presenting with a characteristic expanding rash and potentially causing cardiac, neurological, and joint complications if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|4
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Measles
fields.description: A highly contagious viral infection caused by measles morbillivirus, preventable by vaccination and causing fever, rash, and serious complications including pneumonia and encephalitis.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|5
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Meningitis
fields.description: Inflammation of the meninges caused by bacterial, viral, or fungal pathogens, presenting with fever, headache, and neck stiffness and potentially fatal if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|6
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Pertussis
fields.description: A highly contagious bacterial respiratory infection caused by Bordetella pertussis, characterised by severe paroxysmal coughing and particularly dangerous in infants.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|7
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Tetanus
fields.description: A bacterial infection caused by Clostridium tetani toxin, producing painful muscle spasms and rigidity, with neonatal tetanus a particular risk in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|8
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Varicella and herpes zoster
fields.description: Infection caused by varicella-zoster virus, producing chickenpox on primary infection and reactivating as herpes zoster (shingles) in older or immunocompromised individuals.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|9
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases Category - Z_Other unspecified infectious diseases
fields.description: Infectious diseases not elsewhere classified, including rare, emerging, or unspecified infections not captured in major GBD sub-categories.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|0
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Cardiovascular diseases
fields.description: Diseases of the heart and blood vessels, including ischemic heart disease, stroke, heart failure, and other circulatory conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|1
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Chronic respiratory diseases
fields.description: Long-term diseases affecting the airways and lung parenchyma, including obstructive, restrictive, and inflammatory conditions causing progressive respiratory impairment.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|2
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Diabetes and kidney diseases
fields.description: A GBD grouping encompassing diabetes mellitus and kidney diseases, which share common metabolic risk factors and frequently co-occur.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|3
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Digestive diseases
fields.description: Non-infectious diseases of the gastrointestinal tract and related organs, including the liver, gallbladder, and pancreas.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|4
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Mental disorders
fields.description: Conditions characterised by clinically significant disturbances in cognition, emotion regulation, or behaviour, reflecting dysfunction in psychological or biological processes.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|5
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Musculoskeletal disorders
fields.description: Diseases of bones, joints, muscles, and connective tissue, including osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoporosis, and low back and neck pain.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|6
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Neoplasms
fields.description: Diseases characterised by the uncontrolled growth of abnormal cells, including malignant cancers and benign tumours across all anatomical sites.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|7
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Neurological disorders
fields.description: Diseases affecting the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system, including degenerative, inflammatory, and functional neurological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|8
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Sense organ diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the organs of vision and hearing, including conditions causing visual impairment, blindness, and hearing loss.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|9
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Skin and subcutaneous diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the skin and subcutaneous tissue, including inflammatory, infectious, allergic, and degenerative conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|10
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Substance use disorders
fields.description: Disorders characterised by compulsive use of psychoactive substances despite adverse consequences, including alcohol and drug use disorders.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|11
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases Category - Z_Other non-communicable diseases
fields.description: Non-communicable diseases not classified under the major GBD NCD categories, including congenital, genitourinary, haematological, and other miscellaneous conditions.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|0
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Aortic aneurysm
fields.description: Pathological dilation of the aortic wall with risk of rupture, most commonly involving the abdominal aorta and associated with hypertension and atherosclerosis.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|1
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Atrial fibrillation and flutter
fields.description: Cardiac arrhythmias characterised by rapid and irregular electrical activity in the atria, associated with stroke risk and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|2
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Cardiomyopathy and myocarditis
fields.description: Diseases of the heart muscle including cardiomyopathy and inflammation of the myocardium, leading to impaired cardiac function and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|3
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Endocarditis
fields.description: Infection of the endocardium, most commonly involving the heart valves, caused by bacterial or fungal organisms and associated with significant morbidity and mortality.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|4
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Hypertensive heart disease
fields.description: Structural and functional cardiac disease caused by chronic elevation of blood pressure, leading to left ventricular hypertrophy and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|5
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Ischemic heart disease
fields.description: Reduction in blood supply to the heart muscle due to atherosclerosis of the coronary arteries, presenting as angina, myocardial infarction, or sudden cardiac death.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|6
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Lower extremity peripheral arterial disease
fields.description: Atherosclerotic obstruction of the arteries supplying the lower limbs, causing claudication, ischaemia, and risk of amputation.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|7
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Non-rheumatic valvular heart disease
fields.description: Dysfunction of one or more heart valves not attributable to rheumatic disease, including aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, and degenerative valve conditions.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|8
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
fields.description: Elevated blood pressure in the pulmonary arterial circulation leading to progressive right heart failure and exercise limitation.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|9
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Rheumatic heart disease
fields.description: Cardiac valve damage resulting from repeated episodes of rheumatic fever caused by group A streptococcal throat infection, predominantly affecting children and young adults in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|10
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Stroke
fields.description: Sudden interruption or rupture of blood supply to the brain, causing focal neurological deficits, classified as ischaemic or haemorrhagic in type.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|11
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases Category - Z_Other cardiovascular and circulatory diseases
fields.description: Cardiovascular and circulatory diseases not elsewhere classified in the GBD framework, including peripheral vascular conditions and miscellaneous cardiac disorders.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|0
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Allergic rhinitis
fields.description: Allergic inflammation of the nasal mucosa triggered by inhaled allergens including pollen, dust mites, and moulds, causing sneezing, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhoea.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|1
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Asthma
fields.description: A chronic inflammatory airway disease characterised by reversible bronchoconstriction, wheeze, and airway hyperresponsiveness, triggered by allergens, pollutants, and respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|2
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
fields.description: A progressive, non-reversible obstructive lung disease characterised by persistent airflow limitation, associated with tobacco smoke, indoor and outdoor air pollution, and occupational exposures.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|3
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Interstitial lung disease and pulmonary sarcoidosis
fields.description: A heterogeneous group of diffuse parenchymal lung diseases characterised by inflammation and fibrosis of the lung interstitium, leading to progressive breathlessness and impaired gas exchange.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|4
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Pneumoconiosis
fields.description: Occupational lung diseases caused by chronic inhalation of mineral or organic dusts, including silicosis, coal workers pneumoconiosis, and asbestosis.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|5
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases Category - Z_Other chronic respiratory diseases
fields.description: Chronic respiratory diseases not captured under the specific GBD sub-categories of COPD, pneumoconiosis, asthma, or interstitial lung disease.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|0
fields.title: Diabetes and kidney diseases Category - Acute glomerulonephritis
fields.description: Acute inflammatory disease of the glomeruli, typically immune-mediated, presenting with haematuria, proteinuria, hypertension, and impaired renal function.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|1
fields.title: Diabetes and kidney diseases Category - Diabetes mellitus
fields.description: A group of metabolic diseases characterised by chronic hyperglycaemia resulting from defects in insulin secretion, insulin action, or both, with long-term damage to multiple organ systems.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|2
fields.title: Diabetes and kidney diseases Category - Kidney dysfunction
fields.description: Impaired kidney function assessed by reduced glomerular filtration rate or markers of renal damage, encompassing both chronic and acute kidney conditions.

fields.name: dsny000440_sub|0
fields.title: Kidney dysfunction Category - Acute kidney injury
fields.description: Sudden deterioration of kidney function over hours to days, causing accumulation of waste products and fluid imbalance, often associated with sepsis, dehydration, or nephrotoxic exposure.

fields.name: dsny000440_sub|1
fields.title: Kidney dysfunction Category - Chronic kidney disease
fields.description: Irreversible, progressive loss of kidney function over months to years, classified by stages of declining GFR and associated with cardiovascular risk and need for renal replacement therapy.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|0
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Appendicitis
fields.description: Acute inflammation of the appendix, presenting with right iliac fossa pain and requiring surgical intervention to prevent perforation and peritonitis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|1
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Cirrhosis and other chronic liver diseases
fields.description: Progressive scarring and fibrosis of the liver resulting from chronic injury, including viral hepatitis, alcohol use, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, ultimately causing liver failure.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|2
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Gallbladder and biliary diseases
fields.description: Conditions affecting the gallbladder and bile ducts, including cholelithiasis, cholecystitis, and biliary obstruction.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|3
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Inflammatory bowel disease
fields.description: Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory conditions of the gastrointestinal tract, including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, characterised by relapsing intestinal inflammation.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|4
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Inguinal, femoral, and abdominal hernia
fields.description: Protrusion of abdominal contents through a weakness in the abdominal wall, including inguinal, femoral, and other hernias requiring surgical repair.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|5
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Pancreatitis
fields.description: Acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas, causing abdominal pain and disrupting digestive enzyme and insulin secretion.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|6
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Paralytic ileus and intestinal obstruction
fields.description: Mechanical or functional obstruction of the intestine causing failure of intestinal transit, presenting with pain, distension, and vomiting.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|7
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Upper digestive system diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the oesophagus, stomach, and duodenum, including peptic ulcer disease, gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, and gastritis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|8
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Vascular intestinal disorders
fields.description: Conditions arising from impaired blood supply to the intestinal wall, including mesenteric ischaemia and ischaemic colitis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|9
fields.title: Digestive diseases Category - Z_Other digestive diseases
fields.description: Digestive diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories of liver, upper GI, appendix, hernia, IBD, vascular, gallbladder, or pancreatic disease.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|0
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Anxiety disorders
fields.description: A group of mental disorders characterised by excessive fear or worry disproportionate to circumstances, including generalised anxiety disorder, panic disorder, and phobias.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|1
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by persistent inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that impairs functioning across multiple settings.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|2
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Autism spectrum disorders
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental condition characterised by persistent difficulties in social communication and interaction alongside restricted, repetitive patterns of behaviour.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|3
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Bipolar disorder
fields.description: A mood disorder characterised by episodes of mania or hypomania alternating with depression, causing significant disruption to functioning and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|4
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Conduct disorder
fields.description: A disruptive behavioural disorder characterised by repetitive and persistent patterns of antisocial behaviour, aggression, or violation of social norms.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|5
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Depressive disorders
fields.description: A common mental disorder characterised by persistent low mood, anhedonia, and a range of cognitive, physical, and emotional symptoms causing significant functional impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|6
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Eating disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders characterised by abnormal eating behaviours and distorted body image, including anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge eating disorder.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|7
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Idiopathic developmental intellectual disability
fields.description: Significantly impaired intellectual functioning and adaptive behaviour arising from neurodevelopmental causes, without an identifiable acquired or genetic aetiology.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|8
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
fields.description: A trauma- and stressor-related disorder developing after exposure to actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence, characterised by intrusive symptoms, avoidance, and hyperarousal.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|9
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Schizophrenia
fields.description: A severe chronic mental disorder characterised by positive symptoms (hallucinations, delusions), negative symptoms (blunted affect, social withdrawal), and cognitive impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|10
fields.title: Mental disorders Category - Z_Other mental disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders not classified under the major GBD mental health sub-categories, including other anxiety, dissociative, somatic, and unspecified psychiatric conditions.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|0
fields.title: Neoplasms Category - Malignant skin melanoma
fields.description: A malignant tumour arising from melanocytes in the skin, strongly associated with ultraviolet radiation exposure and with high metastatic potential.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|1
fields.title: Neoplasms Category - Non-melanoma skin cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising from keratinocytes in the skin, including basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, associated with cumulative UV radiation exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|2
fields.title: Neoplasms Category - Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising in the trachea, bronchi, or lung parenchyma, strongly associated with tobacco smoking and air pollution exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|3
fields.title: Neoplasms Category - Z_Other malignant neoplasms
fields.description: Malignant neoplasms not classified under the specific GBD cancer sub-categories, spanning other primary tumour sites and histological types.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|4
fields.title: Neoplasms Category - Z_Other neoplasms
fields.description: Non-malignant tumours that do not invade surrounding tissue or metastasise but may cause local symptoms through mass effect.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|0
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Alzheimer's disease and other dementias
fields.description: Progressive neurodegenerative diseases characterised by cognitive decline, including Alzheimer's disease and other dementias causing loss of memory, reasoning, and functional independence.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|1
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Headache disorders
fields.description: Chronic neurological disorders characterised by recurrent headache, including migraine, tension-type headache, and cluster headache, causing significant disability.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|2
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Idiopathic epilepsy
fields.description: A neurological disorder characterised by recurrent unprovoked seizures due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain, not attributable to an identified structural or metabolic cause.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|3
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Motor neuron disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease causing degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons, leading to progressive paralysis and respiratory failure.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|4
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Multiple sclerosis
fields.description: A chronic autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system, characterised by relapsing or progressive neurological deficits affecting motor, sensory, and cognitive function.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|5
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Parkinson's disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease characterised by tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, and postural instability, caused by loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|6
fields.title: Neurological disorders Category - Z_Other neurological disorders
fields.description: Neurological conditions not classified under the major GBD neurological sub-categories, including rare and unspecified disorders of the nervous system.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|0
fields.title: Sense organ diseases Category - Age-related and other hearing loss
fields.description: Partial or complete loss of hearing attributable to ageing, noise exposure, ototoxic medications, or other causes, affecting communication and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|1
fields.title: Sense organ diseases Category - Blindness and vision loss
fields.description: A spectrum of visual impairment ranging from reduced vision to complete blindness, caused by refractive errors, cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, and infectious causes including trachoma.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|2
fields.title: Sense organ diseases Category - Other sense organ diseases
fields.description: Sense organ diseases not classified under blindness and vision loss or hearing loss, including other ocular and otological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|0
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Acne vulgaris
fields.description: A chronic inflammatory disease of the pilosebaceous unit characterised by comedones, papules, pustules, and nodules, predominantly affecting the face and trunk.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|1
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Alopecia areata
fields.description: An autoimmune condition causing patchy non-scarring hair loss on the scalp or other hair-bearing areas, which may progress to total hair loss.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|2
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Bacterial skin diseases
fields.description: Bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissue, including cellulitis, impetigo, and erysipelas, caused predominantly by Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|3
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Decubitus ulcer
fields.description: Localised skin and underlying tissue injury resulting from prolonged pressure or shear forces, typically over bony prominences in immobile patients.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|4
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Dermatitis
fields.description: Inflammatory skin conditions characterised by erythema, pruritus, and scaling, including atopic dermatitis and contact dermatitis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|5
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Fungal skin diseases
fields.description: Skin infections caused by fungi including dermatophytes (tinea), yeasts (candidiasis), and moulds, particularly prevalent in hot and humid conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|6
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Pruritus
fields.description: A chronic or recurrent sensation of itching without a primary skin lesion, often associated with systemic disease, dry skin, or neuropathic conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|7
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Psoriasis
fields.description: A chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease characterised by scaly erythematous plaques, with systemic associations including psoriatic arthritis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|8
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Scabies
fields.description: A highly contagious skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, causing intense pruritus and a characteristic rash, with crusted scabies occurring in immunocompromised individuals.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|9
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Urticaria
fields.description: An allergic or immune-mediated reaction presenting as transient raised itchy wheals on the skin, often accompanied by angioedema of deeper tissues.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|10
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Viral skin diseases
fields.description: Skin diseases caused by viral pathogens including herpes simplex virus, human papillomavirus (warts), and molluscum contagiosum.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|11
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases Category - Z_Other skin and subcutaneous diseases
fields.description: Skin and subcutaneous diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including rare, unspecified, or miscellaneous dermatological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|0
fields.title: Substance use disorders Category - Alcohol use disorders
fields.description: A chronic disorder characterised by compulsive alcohol consumption, loss of control over drinking, and continued use despite physical and social harm.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|1
fields.title: Substance use disorders Category - Drug use disorders
fields.description: Disorders characterised by compulsive use of illicit or prescription drugs, including opioids, stimulants, and cannabis, with significant harm to health and functioning.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|2
fields.title: Substance use disorders Category - Nicotine dependence
fields.description:
Can you provide a short defintion of nicotine dependence?
12:15

Nicotine dependence is a chronic, relapsing condition characterized by compulsive use of nicotine-containing products (most commonly cigarettes), accompanied by tolerance, a withdrawal syndrome on cessation or reduction, and continued use despite the awareness of harmful consequences.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|0
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Congenital birth defects
fields.description: Structural or functional abnormalities present at birth, including chromosomal disorders and congenital malformations of the heart, limbs, and other organs.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|1
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Endocrine, metabolic, blood, and immune disorders
fields.description: A heterogeneous group of conditions affecting endocrine glands, metabolic processes, and immune function, including thyroid disease, adrenal disorders, and autoimmune conditions. Exception is diabetes, which is captured under "Diabetes and kidney diseases" and more specifically under "Diabetes mellitus".

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|2
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Gynecological diseases
fields.description: Diseases of the female reproductive system, including endometriosis, uterine fibroids, polycystic ovary syndrome, and pelvic inflammatory disease.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|3
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Hemoglobinopathies and hemolytic anemias
fields.description: Inherited disorders of haemoglobin structure or synthesis, including sickle cell disease and thalassaemia, causing haemolytic anaemia and multi-organ complications.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|4
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Oral disorders
fields.description: Conditions affecting the teeth, gums, and oral mucosa, including dental caries, periodontal disease, edentulism, and oral infections.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|5
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Sudden infant death syndrome
fields.description: The sudden unexpected death of an apparently healthy infant, typically during sleep, for which no cause is identified after thorough post-mortem investigation.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|6
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases Category - Urinary diseases and male infertility
fields.description: Conditions affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system, including urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and causes of male infertility.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|0
fields.title: N.3.4 Injuries Category - Self-harm and interpersonal violence
fields.description: Intentional injuries caused by violence directed at oneself or others, including self-harm, assault, sexual violence, and conflict-related injuries.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|1
fields.title: N.3.4 Injuries Category - Transport injuries
fields.description: Injuries sustained in road traffic crashes involving motor vehicles, motorcycles, cyclists, and pedestrians.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|2
fields.title: N.3.4 Injuries Category - Unintentional injuries
fields.description: Injuries that occur without intent to cause harm, including falls, drowning, burns, poisonings, and environmental exposures.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|0
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence Category - Conflict and terrorism
fields.description: Injuries and deaths resulting from organised collective violence, including war, armed conflict, and terrorist attacks.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|1
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence Category - Interpersonal violence
fields.description: Physical, sexual, or psychological harm intentionally inflicted by one person on another, including assault, domestic violence, and sexual violence.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|2
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence Category - Police conflict and executions
fields.description: Deaths and injuries resulting from the use of force by law enforcement or state actors, including fatal police encounters and state-sanctioned executions.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|3
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence Category - Self-harm
fields.description: Intentional injury directed at oneself, including suicidal behaviour and non-suicidal self-injury, across a spectrum from ideation to fatal self-inflicted harm.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|0
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Adverse effects of medical treatment
fields.description: Harm resulting from medical or surgical interventions, including adverse drug reactions, surgical complications, and healthcare-associated infections.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|1
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Animal contact
fields.description: Injuries caused by contact with animals, including bites, stings, and envenomation from snakes, insects, marine animals, and other wildlife.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|2
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Drowning
fields.description: Respiratory impairment resulting from submersion or immersion in liquid, including fatal drowning and non-fatal near-drowning events.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|3
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Electrocution
fields.description: Injury caused by passage of electrical current through the body, including low-voltage electrocution and lightning strike, causing tissue damage, cardiac arrest, and burns.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|4
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Environmental heat and cold exposure
fields.description: Injuries resulting from exposure to extreme environmental temperatures, including heat stroke, heat exhaustion, hypothermia, and frostbite.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|5
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Exposure to forces of nature
fields.description: Injuries directly caused by natural forces including earthquakes, floods, storms, landslides, and volcanic eruptions.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|6
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Exposure to mechanical forces
fields.description: Injuries caused by physical mechanical forces including crushing, cutting, impact, and blast, covering occupational and other unintentional mechanical trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|7
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Falls
fields.description: Injuries resulting from a person falling from one level to another or on the same level, including fractures, head injuries, and soft tissue trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|8
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Fire, heat, and hot substances
fields.description: Injuries to the skin and deeper tissues caused by flames, hot surfaces, scalding liquids, or contact with hot substances.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|9
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Foreign body
fields.description: Injury caused by a foreign object entering the body through ingestion, aspiration, or direct penetration of a body cavity or tissue.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|10
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Poisonings
fields.description: Injury or death resulting from exposure to toxic substances, including medications, household chemicals, pesticides, and environmental toxins.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|11
fields.title: Unintentional injuries Category - Z_Other unintentional injuries
fields.description: Unintentional injuries not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including other accidental exposures and miscellaneous traumatic events.
